races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Racing Excellence - Whips To Be Carried But Not Used)

runners_data.name: Allegrino
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with strong recent form who can control the tempo without early pressure from this field

runners_data.name: Orange Emperor
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent recent effort but poor trainer form and apprentice jockey reduces confidence

runners_data.name: Ahead Of Fashion
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who has shown form on similar ground and should get strong pace to aim at

runners_data.name: Red Moon
runners_data.note: Tendency to fade in the finish makes him vulnerable over this trip despite favorable weight

runners_data.name: Creciente
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner but lightest weight and recent improvement suggest he could outrun odds

races.paceDynamic: Allegrino will lead or sit prominent early with no obvious challenger for the front, creating a sustainable tempo rather than cutthroat fractions. Orange Emperor, Ahead Of Fashion, Red Moon and Creciente all prefer to sit off the pace, meaning Allegrino can dictate terms without pressure through the middle stages. The real race begins in the final two furlongs when the hold-up brigade tries to close down Allegrino's advantage. This race shape clearly favours front-running and prominent racers who can secure good positions early and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Allegrino Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Allegrino gets an easy lead and isn't pressed early
scenarios.body: He dictates a manageable pace and has enough left to resist the late challenge from the hold-up horses. The prominent position proves decisive when the closers struggle to make up ground on soft turf.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swarm
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Allegrino weakens late
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the rearward horses pay dividends as they finish with one run. Orange Emperor and Ahead Of Fashion benefit most from their proven ability to quicken late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up and the hold-up horses encounter trouble
scenarios.body: Allegrino maintains his advantage while others struggle for racing room in the straight. The prominent position becomes even more valuable when rivals can't get clear runs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Red Moon or Creciente produce career-best efforts despite lower ratings
scenarios.body: One of the outsiders times their run perfectly while the principals cancel each other out. The longer odds horses take advantage of a truly-run race.

Orange Emperor faces significant disadvantage with 5lb apprentice claim on soft ground requiring strong jockeyship
Allegrino's 129-day absence could tell late despite his obvious class advantage
Traffic problems likely in straight with four hold-up horses needing room simultaneously

runners_data.name: Kisskodi
runners_data.note: Only confirmed leader with course and distance wins on similar ground but may face late pressure from stronger closers

runners_data.name: Diamondonthehill
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse whose 8-year-old experience could prove decisive in a tactical finish

runners_data.name: The Dragon King
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from in-form Clive Cox yard who can get first run on the hold-up horses

runners_data.name: It'sneverjustone
runners_data.note: David Loughnane's runner has solid course form and the tactical speed to follow moves

runners_data.name: Blue Prince
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good recent form whose 7-day turnaround suggests confidence from connections

runners_data.name: Ararat
runners_data.note: Weak recent form and 5lb claimer suggests this represents a significant step up in class

runners_data.name: Land Of Magic
runners_data.note: Recent winner dropping back from 6f who could benefit if the pace collapses completely

runners_data.name: Spirit Of Breeze
runners_data.note: Long absence is major concern despite 5lb claim and previous course success

races.paceDynamic: Kisskodi will take them along from the front with The Dragon King and It'sneverjustone tracking prominently, but the pace won't be savage with only one confirmed leader in an 8-runner field. The five hold-up horses (Diamondonthehill, Blue Prince, Ararat, Land Of Magic, Spirit Of Breeze) will settle behind the early pace before launching their challenges. With most of the field preferring to come from behind and Kisskodi unlikely to be pressured early, this sets up perfectly for closers who can time their runs right. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish over this 7f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If Kisskodi sets steady fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent horses will be sitting ducks when the cavalry charge arrives from the back, with multiple hold-up runners having clear runs to unleash their finishing kicks. Diamondonthehill and Blue Prince benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Gets First Run
scenarios.trigger: If The Dragon King or It'sneverjustone kicks clear approaching the furlong pole
scenarios.body: They'll steal a march on the hold-up brigade who may get caught flat-footed by the early move. The Dragon King's Clive Cox stable form and It'sneverjustone's David Loughnane polish give them tactical edge over the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Proves Tough
scenarios.trigger: If Kisskodi builds a significant lead and digs deep when challenged
scenarios.body: Harry Eustace's gelding has won twice over course and distance on soft ground and could prove hard to peg back if allowed easy fractions. The hold-up horses may leave their runs too late chasing a resolute leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Kisskodi goes too slow and kills the race as a contest
scenarios.body: The finish becomes a messy scramble where positioning and luck matter more than class, potentially suiting the outsiders who get first run. Land Of Magic's recent win and Spirit Of Breeze's fresh legs could exploit the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Spirit Of Breeze showing any early keenness after 222 days off would signal unreadiness for this competitive handicap
Kisskodi getting loose on the lead early as his stamina may not last if asked to quicken significantly in the final furlong
The Dragon King and It'sneverjustone getting into an early speed duel which would set up the race perfectly for Diamondonthehill
Blue Prince's position turning for home as his hold-up style needs clear running room in this small field
Land Of Magic's ability to settle properly stepping back up to 7f after recent 6f success

races.paceDynamic: Suhub will take the early lead with King's Castle likely pressing or tracking close behind, but with only one confirmed front runner this sets up a sustainable tempo rather than fierce early pace. The majority hold-up horses (Primo Lara, Criminal, Somkiyr, Redbud Sixteen, Huggable, Mighty Quiet, Sixfiveseven, Castle Quarter) will settle towards the rear, creating a large pack to come from off the pace in the home straight. With soft ground testing stamina reserves and a relatively modest early gallop, this race strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks and those with proven soft ground form.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Suhub sets modest fractions and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses get perfect conditions to wind up late runs, with the soft ground sapping the early leaders' reserves. Proven stayers with soft form like Primo Lara and Mighty Quiet can unleash telling late kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent duo steal it
scenarios.trigger: If Suhub and King's Castle break clear turning for home before the closers mobilise
scenarios.body: The two pace-setting horses get first run on their rivals and the soft ground prevents the hold-up brigade from making up the deficit. King's Castle's stamina and Suhub's recent form prove decisive in a front-running finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Suhub goes too slow early and creates a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final quarter-mile, favouring horses with natural pace regardless of official ratings. Criminal and Redbud Sixteen can show their turn of foot when it matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset from outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the principals disappoint and Castle Quarter gets perfect conditions dropping back to handicap company
scenarios.body: The veteran finds improvement after a long break with claiming jockey allowance proving crucial in a weak renewal. Somkiyr also benefits from the chaotic pace scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Kamaway is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and will be allowed to dictate terms without pressure, setting a sustainable gallop from the off. Eutropia may sit prominent as the only other horse with pace tendencies, but the vast majority of this field are hold-up performers who will be tracking from midfield and back. This creates a classic scenario where the pace-setter gets first run while the hold-up brigade face a traffic-laden finish on testing ground. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can position close to the action.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Kamaway gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina on the soft ground
scenarios.body: The pace-setter kicks clear in the straight while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on testing conditions. Eutropia's prominent style gives her the best chance to chase home the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground tells on Kamaway in the final furlong and opens the door
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses finally get organized and one produces a telling late run to collar the tiring leader. Sant Alessio's recent winning form and hold-up style could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Eutropia can get a good position and outstay the front-runner
scenarios.body: The mare's recent wins and ability to race prominently allows her to get first run on the field and hold off late challengers. Her form on similar ground gives her a clear edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both Kamaway and Eutropia fade badly leaving a slow pace throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any hold-up horse with a turn of foot can capitalize on the collapsed pace. Form and class become the key factors rather than tactics.

races.paceDynamic: Twilight Moon will lead from the gates with no serious pace pressure in this small field, allowing Marcus Tregoning's gelding to dictate fractions. Arcturus Flame, Just An Hour and Taritino will track in prominent positions but none are confirmed front-runners who will challenge early. The lack of pace pressure means Twilight Moon can build a significant advantage before the turn for home, forcing the field to come from further back than ideal. This sustainable tempo strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Twilight Moon Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Twilight Moon gets an uncontested lead and maintains his recent form
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable advantage turning for home while the hold-up horses struggle to close the gap on testing ground. Rob Hornby can time his kick perfectly from the front having controlled the race throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can stay close enough to Twilight Moon without over-racing
scenarios.body: Arcturus Flame or Just An Hour travel smoothly in second or third before mounting a sustained challenge in the final two furlongs. The front-runner's stamina cracks under pressure from a well-positioned rival.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows Johnny Boom or Tryfan to get much closer than usual, setting up their preferred late charge. The prominent horses become sitting ducks for the closers who find the gaps late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Taritino Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If Taritino can improve sharply from his prominent position after a recent quick return
scenarios.body: Billy Loughnane uses the 9-day turnaround to keep his mount sharp and launches a telling challenge from close range. The combination of fitness and tactical speed overcomes the top-rated rivals.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Twilight Moon gets more than two lengths clear at halfway as the hold-up horses will struggle to close on this ground
